newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch August cash retail sales rise 7.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch August cash retail sales rise 7.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch retail sales rose 7.1 percent in cash terms in August compared with August 1995, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
In volume terms August retail sales were 7.8 percent higher than in August 1995, the CBS added.
DUTCH RETAIL SALES Aug 96 July 96 Jan-Aug 96
NOTES - The CBS said August 1996 had one Friday and one Saturday more than August 1995 and one Tuesday and one Wednesday less. The figures are not adjusted for such differences.
In non-food there were strong year-on-year rises in August for cash sales in the furniture (12.5 pct), do-it-yourself (12.7 pct), clothing (13.0 pct) and footwear (13.2 pct) segments.
In the food sector supermarkets posted a year-on-year cash sales increase of 6.6 percent, versus a 5.3 percent rise for the food sector as a whole.
